MiniMax M3.latest_note: MiniMax launched M3 as a new multimodal frontier model aimed at long-context coding and agent work.

Qwen3.7-Plus.latest_note: Alibaba released Qwen3.7-Plus as a multimodal agent-focused model, extending Qwen beyond pure text workflows.

Mistral Vibe.latest_note: Mistral repositioned Vibe as one agent for both work tasks and coding, with a stronger emphasis on long-running sessions and connected tools.

Notion Workers.latest_note: Notion’s latest developer-platform rollout pushes its AI stack toward more programmable workplace automation through Workers and agent tooling.

DeepSeek V4.1.latest_note: DeepSeek still has not confirmed a new public release this week, but V4.1 chatter remains strong enough to keep it in the rumor lane.

Siri + Gemini Partnership.latest_note: Fresh WWDC-week reporting strengthened the view that Apple’s next Siri experience will rely on Gemini, making this a notable market-shaping AI distribution story.

GPT-5.5-Cyber.latest_note: OpenAI's GPT-5.5-Cyber was the most concrete new model signal in the June 15-22 window, though access is intentionally restricted.

GPT-5.6 Sol / Terra / Luna.latest_note: GPT-5.6 was the clearest new model release of the week, with staged access and three reported variants.

Claude Mythos 5 / Fable 5.latest_note: Anthropic's Mythos and Fable models moved back toward limited availability after government restrictions, making them active again in this week's model-watch lane.

Claude Sonnet 5.latest_note: Sonnet 5 is the week's clearest new model release, combining stronger agentic execution with broad product and API availability.

Gemma 4 12B and Gemini Omni Flash.latest_note: Google highlighted two complementary model directions: Gemma 4 12B for local multimodal agents and Gemini Omni Flash for API-based video workflows.

Leanstral 1.5.latest_note: Leanstral 1.5 adds a distinct specialized-model story to a week otherwise dominated by general agents and multimodal assistants.

Kimi K2.7 Code.latest_note: Kimi K2.7 Code expanded the competitive coding-model landscape by becoming GitHub Copilot's first selectable open-weight model.

Gemma 4 31B Voice Stack.company: Google DeepMind, Hugging Face, and Cerebras
Gemma 4 31B Voice Stack.latest_note: Gemma 4 31B gained a concrete real-time voice deployment pattern through the Hugging Face and Cerebras open stack.

Claude Opus 5.latest_note: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 with adaptive effort, a one-million-token context window, and broad platform availability.

Kimi K3 Open Weights.latest_note: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3 model weights, code, and a technical report through GitHub and Hugging Face.

MAI-Cyber-1-Flash.latest_note: Microsoft introduced MAI-Cyber-1-Flash as the first specialized model used in Project Perception's MDASH security stack.

NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Edge.latest_note: NVIDIA released Cosmos 3 Edge, a four-billion-parameter world model designed for real-time on-device physical AI.
